# claude.md — Register Errand: Cancellations (tree 139367450)

## Purpose
ETG (eTraveli Group) agent workflow, embedded in Zendesk. For a cancellation contact, the agent looks up the Edvin order, selects PNRs/passengers/channel/type, picks a customer action per PNR, and the tree auto-creates the Zendesk child/silent/grandchild tickets, registers the errand in Edvin, and posts an internal note.

## Architecture (flow)
Root = 10 (Clear session and start fresh order -> continues to 4). Per-PNR intake loop: 10 Clear session (root) -> 4 Find Order -> 6 Select PNRs -> 24 Set order context & channel -> 7 Set Selected PNRs -> 8 Select Passengers -> 9 Format Passengers -> 42 GET Edvin Errands (API) -> 46 Format Types (sets transforms.channel/category OBJECTS) -> 1 Select Channel & Type -> 2 Build actions_array + push PNR -> 11 More PNRs? (loop to 7, else 12).
Then: 12 Create PNR Action Table -> 25 Display table -> 27 Stitch & Group + build child tickets -> 31 Update Tags -> 3 GUARD: any child tickets? -> (32 child-ticket cursor loop: 32->33 Create Child Ticket->35 Grand children?-> [39->41->40->36->37->38] grandchild loop ->34 More child tickets?-> loop 32) else-> 21 Format Internal Note -> 22 Add Internal Note -> 44 register-errands loop (44->43 Register Errand->45 More errands?) -> 23 Closing Call -> 47 Additional request -> 29 Clear Data -> back to 4.

## Data dictionary
- `zendeskChannelIdentifier` (form data): INTERIM manual list box on node 1 (values `zingtree.channels.phone|.chat|.email`), read by node 24 into `channel`. Temporary per A1/CR-004 until Q3 is answered; remove per AC-12.1. Caveat: node 24 (6->24) runs once, before node 1 ever renders, so a selection only takes effect on the NEXT pass through node 24 -- hard Restart or the Additional-request loop -- not the run it was made in. See Changelog 2026-07-29.
- transforms.channel / transforms.category: full Edvin errand-config OBJECTS {id,name,categories}. Set in node 46. Store only .name on PNR items (see node 2).
- transforms.customer_action_pnrs: array of PNR items {pnr, channel(name), channelId, category(name), categoryId, type, typeId, notes, actions_array}. Built in node 2, restitched in node 27.
- actions_array item: {id, name, bucket(STRING), actionId, ...}. bucket normalized to a string in node 2 (bucketKey).
- transforms.child_tickets: [{child_ticket:{...grandchild_tickets:[]}}]. Built node 27 by grouping stitched PNRs on the DISTINCT (type+action) key: proceed -> ONE active child (grandchildren = one per distinct type+action, only when 2+ combos); non-proceed -> ONE silent ticket per distinct (type+action). Consumed node 32 loop.
- transforms.final_pnrs: one entry per distinct (type+action). Built node 27 (deduped), consumed by node 21 (internal note per-errand blocks) and node 44 (registers one Edvin errand each).
- Counters (form data, no TTL): child_tickets_count, grandchild_tickets_count; booleans is_more_child_tickets, is_grandchild_tickets, is_more_grandchild_tickets, is_more_pnrs, isMorePNR.
- actions.edvin__errand_configuration, actions.get_edvin_prop_long_value: Edvin API responses.

## External systems (CX Actions / Connected Objects)
Edvin: Find Order (4), GET Edvin Errands (42), Register Errand (43). Zendesk: Update Tags (31), Create Child Ticket (33), Create Grandchild Ticket (37), Get Side Conversations (40), Add Internal Note (22).

## Conventions & gotchas
- Transforms expire after 1 hour; node 29 Clear Data resets loop state so the outer "Additional request" loop restarts clean.
- Node 3 guard (len(transforms.child_tickets) >= 1) MUST stay before node 32 — node 32->33 creates a Zendesk ticket unconditionally, so an empty set has to skip to 21.
- bucket routing keys: proceed | no_action | escalate | different_request (default => silent ticket).
- GROUPING KEY (v11): distinct errand = (type + customer_action) together, NOT action alone. Governs grandchild count, silent-ticket count, and Edvin errand count. Confirmed 2026-07-28 against ETG_ZT errand tracker - Testing.csv.
- API fields that arrive as OBJECTS (channel, category, bucket) must be reduced to their scalar/name form at the producer (node 2 / 46), never rendered/interpolated raw (=> "[object Object]") or .trim()'d (=> "no member 'trim'").

- customer_action_pnrs de-dup (v8): node 2 UPSERTS by pnr (findIndex on pnr -> overwrite else push), never a blind push. Node 24 also re-inits customer_action_pnrs/final_pnrs/pnr_index at the start of each run. Together they stop duplicate PNR action cards on node 12/25 caused by Back-nav, Restart, or ?session_id= deep-resume re-entering node 2 for an already-recorded PNR.
- Restart clears state (v8): root is now Script node 10, which resets ALL intake + child/grandchild loop transforms and loop form-data counters/flags. Native Restart returns to root -> runs node 10 -> clean slate. A deep-resume (?session_id=) re-enters at the last content node and SKIPS node 10, preserving the in-progress session. Inbound query params are never cleared.
- persist_node_ids fixed 28 -> 29 (v8): 28 was deleted; 29 is Clear Data (matches persist_names).

## Changelog
- 2026-07-29 - Claude(Wes)/Brent - Restored the interim manual `zendeskChannelIdentifier` list box on node 1 (options Phone/Chat/Email submitting zingtree.channels.phone/.chat/.email as the option text/value), per A1/CR-004 in register-errands-dynamic-requirements.md. It had been dropped during a premature attempt to auto-resolve the channel, which is what left node 46's `actions.get_edvin_prop_long_value` reference crashing (that CO wiring is being handled separately by Brent, out of scope here). Node 24's existing read (`ZT.getVariableValue("zendeskChannelIdentifier", "")` -> `channel`) is unchanged. TIMING CAVEAT for the next author: node 24 runs once, at 6->24, BEFORE node 1 first renders anywhere in the tree, so a selection made on node 1 has no effect on the run in progress -- `channel` for that run is whatever `zendeskChannelIdentifier` held (typically "", unless an inbound Zendesk query param supplied it) at 6->24 time. The selection only takes effect the NEXT time node 24 runs: a hard Restart (root node 10 -> 4 -> 6 -> 24) or the Additional-request loop (23 -> 47 -> 29 -> 4 -> 6 -> 24) -- neither node 10 nor node 29 clears zendeskChannelIdentifier or channel (both are treated as inbound-query-param-like and deliberately preserved), so the prior run's selection carries forward. Flagged for Brent, not fixed here (out of scope for this single-node edit -- would require moving the selector earlier in the flow, e.g. onto node 6). Remove the field entirely once Q3 is answered, per AC-12.1. nodes 1,5
- 2026-07-28 - Claude(Wes)/Brent - v11: (type+action) grouping fix in node 27. Grandchild key -> type|action (kept the >1-distinct-combo guard); silent tickets now one per distinct (type+action) instead of one per bucket; final_pnrs deduped to one entry per distinct (type+action) so Edvin registers one errand each; node 27 readback now sanitizes the PNR identically to node 12 (stitch-key hardening); dropped the dead pnr_buckets transform write. Fixes errand-tracker tests T2/T5/T6a/T8 (grouping) and T4/T7 (errand dedup); T1/T3/T6b unchanged/pass. NOTE: final_pnrs is also read by node 21 for the internal note - its per-PNR blocks now show one per distinct (type+action); all PNRs still appear via the joined child-ticket summary. nodes 27,5
- 2026-07-27 - Claude(Wes)/Brent - v8: fixed duplicate PNR action cards. Node 2 now upserts by pnr; node 24 re-inits intake accumulators at run start; NEW Script root node 10 clears all intake+loop transforms and loop form data on fresh start/Restart (deep-resume skips it); root_node_id 4->10, node 4 is_root 0; persist_node_ids 28->29. nodes 2,24,10(new),4,5, tree config
- 2026-07-26 · Claude/Brent · Fixed channel/category rendering: store .name on PNR items (node 2). · nodes 2
- 2026-07-26 · Claude/Brent · Node 32 crash: added guard node 3 (len(child_tickets)>=1), counter clamp in 32, loop-state resets in 29. · nodes 3,31,32,29
- 2026-07-26 · Claude/Brent · "no member 'trim'": node 2 now maps API actions & normalizes bucket to a string (bucketKey), restores actionId; logs raw bucket shape. Removed dead node 28; retitled 24 & 41; added this claude.md node. · nodes 2,24,41,28(del),5(new)
- 2026-07-26 · Claude/Brent · Added contact_reason native select on node 6 (13 Edvin categories); wired CONTACT_REASON in nodes 46 & 2 to ZT.getVariableValue("contact_reason"). Contact reason is now agent-selected, not hardcoded to Cancellation. · nodes 6,46,2,5
- 2026-07-26 · Claude/Brent · v5: rebuilt node 6 contact_reason field to mirror proven select schema (added scores key, checkbox_score=0) to fix Zingtree import error. · nodes 6
- 2026-07-26 · Claude/Brent · v6: removed node 6 contact_reason dropdown; added CONTACT_REASON_BY_ZENDESK map in nodes 2 & 46 reading custom_field_29559177650834 (Zendesk) -> Edvin category name. Interim until Edvin API returns a matching value. schedule_change has no Edvin category. · nodes 6,2,46,5
